resources.string: A soothing tune that plays while NumbCrunch is open.
Keypad notes, button taps, clue chimes, SMYLE and winner applause.
Couldn\'t save that setting. Check your device storage and try again.
Crack the hidden code by finding all three digits in the right order. Each guess gives you clues. There is no guess limit: take your time and let logic lead.
Use exactly 3 different digits from 0 to 9. No repeats, in the secret or your guesses. Zero can come first: 012 is a valid code.
Every guess gives you a remark. R counts digits in the correct place. W counts digits in the secret that belong somewhere else. Winner means all three digits are correctly placed.
Select your first guess by entering 3 unique digits, and see following (combination of) clues to help with your next guess.
When any number of guessed digits exist in the hidden number, AND entered in RIGHT place, the clue is displayed as 1R or 2R.
When any number of guessed digits exist in the hidden number, BUT entered in WRONG place, the clue is displayed as 1W, 2W or 3W.
The clue showing 1W, 2W or 3W represents number of guessed digits existing in the hidden number, but entered in the WRONG place in the attempted guess.
When ALL 3 digits in the attempted guess are absent in the hidden number, the player is rewarded with SMYLE, \"Simply Make Your Life Easy\", and ignore these 3 digits in your next guess.
SMYLE means none of your digits are in the secret. It stands for Simply Make Your Life Easy: three digits you can rule out!
Choose a difficulty on Home before you start. Each difficulty works with both player modes.
Easy\nEvery submitted guess shows a clue on all three tiles using colors and marks.

Medium\nSubmitted tiles start gray. During the round, tap Hint beside a submitted guess to reveal the colors and marks on all three tiles in that row. You get one hint per round, and the other rows stay gray.
Hard\nAll submitted tiles stay gray. Use the remarks to work out which digits match.

Green tiles show R for a digit in the right place.
Yellow tiles show W for a digit that belongs in another place.
Red tiles show a cross (×) for a digit absent from the secret.
Unmarked gray tiles keep individual clues hidden. Use the remark for the row.

Every digit is in the right place. You cracked it!
Single Player\nThe app picks a random secret. You do the detective work.
Double Player\nA friend enters a secret on Home. The input is masked. Hand the phone to the seeker, who guesses the code using the same rules. Both players share one device.

Tap digits on the keypad. A digit already in your current guess is disabled. DELETE removes the last digit. ENTER checks a complete three-digit guess.

Tap a remark to read what it means. Scroll the board to compare earlier guesses.

The ? button opens this guide and the gear opens Settings. Go back to resume your round. Back or a sideways swipe asks before leaving an unfinished round. SHOW asks before ending the round and revealing the secret.

After winning, HOME returns to setup. In Single Player, PLAY AGAIN starts a new round at the same difficulty with a fresh secret.

Compare the R and W counts across several guesses. Rearrange the same digits to explore positions, or change digits to narrow down which ones belong in the code.\n\nA SMYLE row eliminates three digits. You have unlimited guesses, so experiment at your own pace.

This game is to find a hidden number with 3 unique digits from 0 to 9 (no repeat) by guessing. Each guess opens a clue to help find the hidden number. 

In single player mode, the player would need to find the hidden number by the game. In double player mode, one player will hide the number and the other will try to find it using guesses.

On Home, choose a difficulty before you tap Start.

From this row, keep 5 at the end and leave 3 out. Since 2 cannot be in the middle and 5 fills the last slot, 2 must go first. The middle digit is still unknown.

The practice secret is %1$s. This practice uses Hard difficulty, with gray tiles and a remark for each guess. Enter any three different digits and tap ENTER. Try a few guesses, or enter the secret to see Winner.

NumbCrunch is simple to learn, but every round invites another thoughtful deduction. Like tic-tac-toe, a small set of rules can open the door to strategy. Notice patterns, remember clues and test possibilities—practice helps you find the code with more confidence, one reasoned step at a time.

In our family, the story of NumbCrunch began long before Wordle became a household name. Its inventor, Paresh Langalia—Keval\'s elder brother and mentor—created the game to play with his children and nurture their curiosity and reasoning.\n\nKeval began the Android project on May 11, 2021. The rules are simple; the challenge is in connecting each clue. Compare your guesses, rule out what cannot fit and let each new hint guide the next. With practice, players can solve more efficiently—not by memorizing a shortcut, but by reasoning through the code.
A quick puzzle to share or solve solo. Each round rewards curiosity, attention and the satisfaction of making a clue click.
Created by Keval Langalia.\nBuilt for Android with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
NumbCrunch collects no personal information. It has no ads, no accounts and no internet access, and everything it remembers stays on your device.
